title: Data acquisition and splitting
action: Download the public DFT formation energy dataset from Zenodo (DOI:10.5281/zenodo.10854500). Parse all structures and separate them into two sets: ordered structures (≤8 atoms) for training, and SQS structures (≥27 atoms) for testing. Extract the formation energy target for each structure.
description: Prepare the training and test sets from the published dataset

title: Train ALIGNN on ordered structures
action: Train an ALIGNN model on the formation energies of the ordered structures (≤8 atoms) using the ALIGNN implementation.
description: Train ALIGNN on ordered structures for the Ordered→SQS generalization task.

title: Predict formation energies of SQS structures
action: Use the trained ALIGNN model to predict the formation energy for every SQS structure (≥27 atoms). Record structure_id, true_formation_energy (eV/atom), predicted_formation_energy (eV/atom).
description: CSV with true and predicted formation energies for all SQS test structures, used to compute out-of-distribution MAE (Ordered→SQS).
